Experience with Telecommunications tasks, related to the installation of vendor services, telecom services, collaboration services, features and functionality supported by IT Unified Communication.Demonstrated ability to communicate technical information to technical and non-technical personnel at various levels in the organization.
Experience with the change control and enterprise notification to coordinate changes within a 24/7 environment

As part of UCDH IT, Unified Communications (UC) provides planning, implementation and operational activities to deliver Wide Area Network (WAN), Local Area Network (LAN), Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP), Private Branch Exchange (PBX) telephones, wireless, video, voicemail, automated call distribution (ACD) and workstation service for the entire UCDH enterprise. In response to institutional requirements, the department provides technological support for the cost-effective use of computers, software, telecommunications, video and networking to include installation, training and problem resolution.
30% - Cisco LAN/WAN/WLAN and VoIP Technologies - Implementation

The Network and VoIP Analyst will assist UC team in maintaining 24×7×365 high availability and mission critical voice and data network. The Network and VoIP Analyst will be responsible for resolving daily voice and data network issues in response to IT Operations Center alerts and escalations. This may involve working with Security Team, project managers and other staff in order to resolve a multitude of voice and data network adds moves and changes, repairs, monitoring and performance issue’s.
30% - Network and VoIP operations and monitoring

The Network and VoIP Analyst is an experienced professional who knows how to apply theory and put it into practice with in-depth understanding of the professional field; independently performs the full range of responsibilities within the function; possesses broad job knowledge; analyzes problems/issues of diverse scope and determines solutions.
30% - Cisco LAN/WAN/WLAN and VoIP - Troubleshooting

Under general direction, the Network and VoIP Analyst applies skills as a seasoned, experienced communications professional with a full understanding of industry practices and relevant policies and procedures.

The Network and VoIP Analyst is an experienced and qualified technical professional in the area of configuring, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of local and wide area network, including but not limited to routers, switches, VPN, WLAN, VoIP, authentication servers, load balancers, security technologies and network monitoring tools. Under general direction, the Network and VoIP Analyst is recognized as an experience professional in network support services of UCDH with responsibility for enterprise-wide voice, video and data network support. The Network and VoIP Analyst must have the knowledge, skills and abilities to make decisions that broadly affect the entire UCDH.
Able to learn effectively and meet deadlines.
Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team.
Demonstraed diverse problem solving skills.
